title: Low Rivers, High Water

mood.label: Records and wreckage
mood.summary: August tied the hottest month ever measured while Europe's rivers ran low, Brent broke $101 under strikes in Hormuz, and a ferry fire off Palawan left 87 missing. Khartoum's first wartime talks are the small light.

style.genre: slow industrial elegy - tubular bells, kalimba, timpani

lines: August came back and tied its own record,
one point six five, and the rivers ran thin.
The Rhine showed its bones, the Danube went quiet —
we call it a record. Nobody wins.
Off Palawan the ferry burned in the dark,
five they have counted, eighty-seven they don't.
Oil crossed a hundred on smoke in the strait;
the diesel signs climbed like they always will.
But somebody sat down in Khartoum this morning,
and Libya wrote a date on a page.
Low rivers, high water, the year keeps its ledger —
small light, still light, at this stage.
